caption.en: The act enabled the division of collectively held Indigenous land into individual allotments.
caption.zh: 该法授权将原住民集体持有土地分割为个人配地。

alt.en: An official law page with formal congressional heading.
alt.zh: 带正式国会标题的法律书页。

interpretation.en: The law documents a federal allotment policy, not Indigenous consent to the loss of communal land.
interpretation.zh: 法律记录联邦配地政策，并不代表原住民同意失去集体土地。

title.zh: 购买阿拉斯加的国库付款凭证

items.creator: United States Department of the Treasury

caption.en: The $7.2 million payment warrant followed the 1867 treaty and transfer by a year.
caption.zh: 七百二十万美元付款凭证比1867年条约及交接晚一年。

alt.en: A decorated treasury warrant with handwritten amount and signatures.
alt.zh: 带装饰的国库凭证，上有手写金额与签名。

interpretation.en: Evidence of payment between governments is not evidence that Alaska Native communities consented to the transfer.
interpretation.zh: 政府之间付款的证据，并不证明阿拉斯加原住民社群同意转让。

items.creator: United States commissioners and Navajo representatives

caption.en: The treaty signed at Fort Sumner enabled Diné people to leave confinement and return to part of their homeland.
caption.zh: 在萨姆纳堡签署的条约使迪内人得以离开拘禁并返回部分家园。

alt.en: Commissioners’ signatures and named Navajo signatories’ marks on a treaty page.
alt.zh: 条约页上列有委员签名与纳瓦霍签署人的姓名及画押。

interpretation.en: A contemporary signature page, not a picture of the Long Walk. The treaty belongs to the history of return after forced removal.
interpretation.zh: 这是当时的签署页，并非长途迁徙场景图；条约属于强制迁移之后返回家园的历史。

title.en: Cherokee protest against the New Echota treaty
title.zh: 切罗基人反对新埃乔塔条约的请愿书

items.creator: Cherokee petitioners of Aquohee and Taquoee districts

caption.en: Petitioners asked the United States Senate not to ratify an agreement made without authorization from their national council or people.
caption.zh: 请愿者请求美国参议院不要批准未经其民族议会或民众授权订立的协议。

alt.en: A handwritten petition protesting the New Echota treaty.
alt.zh: 反对新埃乔塔条约的手写请愿书。

interpretation.en: This 1836 protest precedes the 1838 forced removal and shows that the treaty was contested rather than a collective agreement to leave.
interpretation.zh: 1836年抗议早于1838年强制迁移，表明条约受到争议，并非集体同意离开。
